notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749585/6d0d25bd63e63511bc650c7a1d262cf6b831a84f.jpg

Tormenture receives a major update

We're excited to share that a new patch has just gone live. It brings a host of fixes, usability improvements, and full support for both Chinese and Catalan languages.

This update also includes significant optimization work, especially for lower-end systems, resulting in performance boosts of up to 300%. Tormenture is also now fully compatible with Steam Deck, running smoothly at 60 FPS on Ultra settings.

Overview
     Chinese & Catalan localization
     Input remapping for both keyboard/mouse and gamepad
     Major optimization improvements (up to +300% performance)
     New zoom mechanic for small-screen visibility
     General bug fixes and usability tweaks

Changelog

[MENUS]
     Added a new photosensitivity warning screen
     Improved overall menu navigation and added a new "back" sound cue
     Introduced a new Input Settings menu with sensitivity sliders and a full input remapping system
[SAVE GAME]
 Optimized save file handling to reduce read/write frequency
[(3D) ROOM ENVIRONMENT]
     Batteries now correctly disappear after use
     Improved item grabbing system for better interaction with 3D objects
     Fixed an issue where the wooden box wouldn’t open after inserting both pieces
     Optimized visual fidelity of some environment objects
     Enhanced behavior of book-type 3D items
     Added extra zoom functionality when inspecting the Guess Who game
[FOREST]
     Minor layout adjustments
     Fixed a potential softlock after the orange lock door
[MANSION]
     Improved clarity at the end of the Artist Room sequence
[RUINS]
     Fixed enemies occasionally moving through walls
     Addressed visual glitches during the Ruins boss 3D sequence
[CAVES]
     Minor layout tweaks in several rooms
     All interactables are now functional in darkness
     Fixed a phone maze exploit that allowed players to bypass it
     Resolved an issue where pushable blocks couldn’t be moved after being caught by a phone maze hand
     Fixed abnormal behavior with blinds and ceiling lamps
[MAZE]
     Final Boss hitbox now behaves correctly during teleportation
     Addressed a potential softlock during the second phase of the Final Boss
[LOCALIZATION]
     Multiple localization bugs fixed
     Added full Catalan and Chinese language support
[GLOBAL]
     Fixed an issue where items became ungrabbable if the currently held item was destroyed
     Solved occasional music dropouts
     Added subtitles in key moments to enhance understanding across languages
     Massive performance improvements on lower-end systems (up to +300%)
     Fully Steam Deck compatible, now running Ultra at 60+ FPS
     Added a new zoom mechanic for better visibility of held 3D objects on smaller screens
     Various other minor fixes and improvements

Version: 1.0.3 (Build 20052025101400)

notes.title: Tormenture has a limited 45% discount until April 21st!
notes.content:
We’re glad to announce that Tormenture is going to be 45% off during this week, from April 14th until April 21st!

“A bizarre and unsettling adventure, well designed and full of smart decisions” is how MeriStation describes the experience of Tormenture. 

Don’t miss out on this limited chance to get the game and the OST with an incredible deal!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2545220/Tormenture/

A dive into the past of videogames

While offering a chilling and spooky adventure, Tormenture will take you back to the 80s and a time of classic games, where you had to figure out puzzles with a pencil and a notebook and you had to blow on cartridges to get them working when they wouldn't load. Are you prepared to take on this cursed game?

The Billete Cohete Team

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749585/7b9451c394de5892af51a878c6c0e89074e96b5e.png

“It provides a nostalgic vision of yesteryear’s gaming laced with a bit of horror” that’s how the media outlet Destructoid described Tormenture, and now you can experience it at 35% off for a very limited time! This exclusive deal is available only for one week, from March 4th to March 10th. 

Try the Demo!

During the Steam Next Fest, we made the **Tormenture Demo available** for players to try out, and due to the great response, we’ve decided to keep it live! If you haven’t played it yet, now’s your chance to dive into the world of Tormenture and see what it’s all about before getting the full experience.

Exciting Updates on the Way!

We’re working on a major update packed with improvements, and surprises! Stay tuned for more details coming soon—you won’t want to miss what we have in store.

The Billete Cohete Team

notes.title: Tormenture joins the Steam Winter Sale with a big discount!
notes.content:
We’re glad to let you know that Tormenture has a 30% discount for the Steam Winter Sale, and to accompany it the OST is discounted too! The Winter cold is almost upon us, and we’re sure you’d rather stay at home playing videogames, reminiscing about the good old times. And for that, there’s nothing better than playing Tormenture and getting that 80’s feeling!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749585/ad40bf6c04f02cc70be5b9e69baeccae0257ec53.gif

A cursed horror game inside another game, set on the 80’s

Be transported to the 80’s, to a child’s room in which you will be playing the cursed game and interacting with classic toys that will help you unlock hidden secrets. Inspired by classic horror games, Tormenture features nostalgic mechanics and controls in a fully immersive 3D environment.

It’s truly a “game within a game,” designed to keep you questioning what’s real and what’s not… Wait, can a discount this good even be real?


The Billete Cohete Team.


“A must-play game for horror and classic enthusiasts” 8.5 – Vandal.

“It creates a different kind of feeling, the one you had as a child when you were left alone at home during nighttime” - Steam User Review.

notes.content:

Check out the full details below:

[CAVES BOSS]

Fixed the bug that canceled the cinematic after dying before completing the puzzle in the caves.

[JAPANESE LOCALIZATON]

Japanese translation fixes.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 + Japanese language update
notes.content:
Release Notes for 1.0.2 - 14 November 2024
 
[LANGUAGES]

New Content! Added support for Japanese language.

[GAMEPLAY]

 Fixed a crash that occurred when the player died during a cutscene.
 Resolved an issue causing the game to freeze in 2D environments where the player character is not visible and no actions can be performed.
* Note: This issue specifically occurs in the Forest's Burnables and Sokoban Room locations.
 Addressed a bug where the player could gain temporary immunity when hit simultaneously by a specific glitch. (Decision pending on disclosure)

[BOSSES]

 Corrected a bug where the player could die and remain off-screen without control following the start of a boss animation, causing the action in the 3D room to continue without player interaction.

[CAVES]

 Fixed a crash triggered by pressing Ctrl or Tab during the loading of the cave darkness effect.


Don’t stop sharing your impressions of the game with us! Your wonderful reviews are greatly helping us improve. Keep them coming!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
We’re excited to share that a new update for Tormenture is now live! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749585/6f4af7a27b7751787692441b18303c33f57c0a40.png

Thanks to our amazing community, we’ve fixed different bugs and made important tweaks based on your comments and reviews. Your input really helps us make the game better. Check out the detailed changelog at the end of this announcement.
 
We are humbled by the kind words you’ve shared in your reviews—they are essential to the game’s success and visibility in the store. Thank you!
 

Overview

 Soft-Locks
 Save system
 Bosses
 Map
 Other minor fixes


Change log
 
[MENUS] 

Fixed the Easter Eggs pop-up that appeared at the beginning of the game.
 

[TUTORIAL] 

Fixed the Dragon Enemy whose charge attack could cause it to go off-screen.
 

[SAVE GAME] 

Fixed issues that caused save game loss, where the "Continue" button would disappear upon returning to the main menu. 

Added a backup system to restore corrupted save files.
 

[(3D) ROOM ENVIRONMENT] 

Added accessibility improvements for the Speak'n'Spell Item. Spelling words will now appear subtitled. 

Fixed inconsistencies with the 3D models of notes.  

Fixed issues when lowering the blinds in the room. 

Corrected an interaction issue with the plush toy after acquiring the Torch Item.
 

[HUB / MAP CENTER]  

The Lever Item will not disappear when the Player carries it out of the zone and drops it or continues after a game over. The Item will always return to its original location and can be retrieved via the river channel or by entering the Village Zone through the forest.
 

[MAP] 

Fixed issues related to loading between zones. 
 

[FOREST] 

Adjusted sokoban mechanics to allow planting seeds after the sokoban has passed over them.
 

[MANSION] 

Adjusted the Mirror Enemy in the Mansion Zone.
 

[RUINS] 

Fixed issues with the Turret Enemy in the Ruins Zone. 

Fixed the hands of the Ruins Boss that were blocking progression to the next phase of the Boss fight. 

The Tape Item in the Ruins Zone will no longer reappear after completing its puzzle.
 

[CAVES] 

Improved performance for the Cave Boss. 

Adjusted the movement of the Lurker enemy in the Cave Zone. The enemy will no longer move if the game is paused or during its introductory scene. 

Fixed the death animation of the NPC “Big Head”.
 

[MAZE] 

Fixed an issue in the Maze where the player could pass through the yellow door with the Small Dot  Item, blocking their progress. 

Adjusted the Bridge Item to prevent the player from getting stuck and allow it to be grabbed from a greater distance. 

Various fixes in the first phase of the Final Boss. The Boss will no longer teleport outside the Gaming Area, and the sound of its attacks will not persist after a game over.

Known issues

 Beware of using Steam cloud saves across different devices. Please make sure you client has synchronized properly with the cloud before starting the game
 Some people are experiencing a black screen right at the begining of the game. This is caused by the NVidia Fast V-Sync option. Please set the Fast V-Sync option to off in the nvidia panel
 If for any reason you think you have lost your save game, please reach us at #tormenture-help in our Discord server (link available in the Steam page)
